_about: Registry of passive-tree flags and node tags. Every flag a tree node uses must be listed here and must have a behavioural test (tests/test_passive_tree.gd, func flag_<id>). kind 'behaviour' = code reacts to the flag; 'marker' = the node's mods do the work and the flag only names it. Checked by scripts/core/tree_rules.gd.
_abyss_about: Bonus passive points: +1 the first time the Endless Abyss record (progress.abyss_best) reaches each depth. 59 (levels) + 6 (first boss kill per tier) + 7 = 72 = budget_l60. Derived from abyss_best, so retroactive.

momentum.desc: Consecutive hits within 2s stack 3% more damage (max 20); 10% less with no stacks.

fortress.desc: 30% damage reduction after standing still for 1s.

perfect_aim.desc: Projectiles: 30% more beyond 180 units, 30% less within 100.

convergence.desc: Fire vs chilled/shocked or cold/lightning vs ignited: 35% more; 10% less vs unafflicted.

blood_magic.desc: Skills cost life instead of mana.

vampiric.desc: 2% of hit damage leeched as life.

crimson_dance.desc: Bleeds deal 60% more and last 50% longer.

wind_dancer.desc: Dodge grants Wind Dance (40% more damage); 10% less without it.

executioner.desc: Hits vs enemies below 35% life always crit.

mind_over_matter.desc: 30% of damage taken comes from mana first.

void_pact.desc: 25% more damage vs enemies with any ailment.

blood_scent.desc: Killing a bleeding enemy restores 4% life.

blood_frenzy.desc: +4% attack speed per bleeding enemy within 150 (max 5); 10% more physical taken; no regen above 50% life.

counterweight.desc: Blocking grants 40% increased melee damage for 2s.

iron_riposte.desc: Block triggers a 55-radius weapon counterattack (0.5s ICD); no dodge roll; movement skills cost 50% more.

rallying_cry.desc: Killing a stunned enemy resets the shortest remaining cooldown.

war_herald.desc: Buff skills last 50% longer and stun enemies within 70.

volatile_mechanisms.desc: Turrets explode on expiry/replacement; traps detonate instead of fizzling.

overclock.desc: Turrets fire 25% faster while the owner is within 120.

clockwork_mind.desc: Turret/trap hits use weapon crit if higher; other hits 30% less.

agonising_toxins.desc: 10% poison chance; poison stacks to 3; 3 stacks inflict Agony.

virulence.desc: A dying poisoned enemy passes its poison to the nearest enemy within 90.

venom_pact.desc: 20% poison chance; poison stacks to 20 and lasts 40% longer; hits cannot crit.

marked_for_death.desc: Projectile crits Mark for 2s; crits vs Marked also hit one nearby enemy.

funeral_pyre.desc: Killing an ignited enemy: 20% inc fire damage, 10% inc cast speed for 3s.

avatar_of_embers.desc: Cold and lightning convert to fire; chill/freeze/shock become ignite.

marrow_feast.desc: A minion that kills recovers 20% life.

necrotic_orders.desc: Minion hits: 20% chance to inflict Frailty.

legion_of_bone.desc: +2 minions (mods); minions explode for 40% of their life on death; drawbacks in mods.

frailty_bloom.desc: A dying enemy with Frailty spreads it within 80.

hexblight.desc: Hits vs Frailty/Snare: 25% chance to inflict Agony.

hunter_knight.desc: Melee hits: 20% chance to Mark an unmarked enemy for 2s. Projectile hits vs Marked: +15% crit chance.

pinning_shot.desc: Projectile hits vs Marked enemies Snare for 1.5s.

run_them_down.desc: Melee hits vs Snared or Chilled enemies: +20% crit chance.

twin_disciplines.desc: Melee after projectile (or the reverse): 25% more damage; same kind twice in a row: 10% less.

hexshot.desc: First projectile hit of each skill use applies the last curse you cast.

overload.desc: Killing a Shocked enemy shocks enemies within 80 and deals 10% of its max life as lightning to them.

spell_archer.desc: spell_damage increases also apply to projectile attacks; 15% less attack speed (mods).

spellblade.desc: Melee hits release a 50-radius burst of the last spell's element for 30% of the hit (0.6s ICD); fire ignites, cold chills, lightning shocks.

rime_edge.desc: Melee hits vs Chilled enemies: 25% chance to Freeze.

shatter.desc: Killing a Frozen enemy chills enemies within 60 and deals 10% of its max life as cold to them.

battlemage.desc: spell_damage increases apply to melee attacks and melee_damage increases to spells; 15% less max life (mods).

brutal_force.desc: Melee hits vs Stunned or Frozen enemies always crit.

second_wind.desc: A hit that leaves you below 35% life: regenerate 20% max life over 4s (20s cooldown).

deadeye_mastery.desc: Projectile hits vs enemies more than 160 units away Snare for 1.5s.

engineers_doctrine.desc: Turret and trap hits: 15% chance to Shock.

pyroclasm.desc: Ignited enemies explode on death: 10% of max life as fire within 60.

commanders_edge.desc: Minions use your crit chance increases (flat + inc) and crit multiplier.

rift_step.desc: Blink Snares enemies within 60 of the departure and arrival points for 2s.

festering_wounds.desc: Bleed, ignite and poison on Snared or Marked enemies last 50% longer.

elemental_warding.desc: Ignite, chill, freeze and shock on you last 50% shorter.

prismatic_soul.desc: Immune to ignite, chill, freeze and shock; cannot inflict them. Stats in mods.

tailwind.desc: Dash, leap or blink resets the dodge roll cooldown.

deathblow.desc: Crit kill: 20% inc crit chance, 10% inc attack and cast speed for 3s.

arcane_shell.desc: Hit of 15%+ max life: +20% damage reduction for 3s (8s cooldown).

abyssal_gaze.desc: Void and arcane hits: 15% chance to inflict Frailty for 4s.

tremor_lines.hook: Combat.player_packet (slam snare) / apply_status (stun on snared x1.5)
tremor_lines.desc: Slam hits snare 1.5s; stuns on snared enemies last 50% longer.

shockwave.desc: Killing a stunned enemy: 70-unit burst, 10% of its max life as physical, stuns.

earthbreaker.desc: Slam skills 35% more damage and always stun; 20% less attack speed (mods).

feint.desc: Next melee hit within 2s of a dodge roll is a critical strike.

single_combat.desc: Melee hits vs an enemy with no other enemy within 110 Mark it for 3s.

blade_dance.desc: Melee crits: +5% attack and move speed per stack for 3s (max 4).

barbed_snares.desc: Trap hits snare 2s and have 30% chance to bleed.

noxious_payload.desc: Trap hits poison snared enemies; poison on snared enemies stacks to 5; 5 stacks = agony.

master_trapper.desc: +1 max per trap, traps arm instantly, 30% more trap damage; cannot deploy turrets.

volley_fire.desc: Multi-projectile attacks +2 projectiles; single-projectile attacks +1 pierce.

arrowstorm.desc: Every 10th projectile attack hit: 3 arrow volleys (r40) at 40% of the hit.

endless_quiver.desc: Projectile attacks: 15% chance to fire again.

conductive_web.desc: Shocking an enemy also shocks the nearest unshocked enemy within 90.

thunderhead.desc: Every 4th lightning spell: bolt on the enemy nearest the target, 150% damage, shocks.

static_cascade.desc: Lightning hits vs shocked enemies arc to another enemy within 100 for 50%.

cold_snap.desc: Freezing an enemy chills enemies within 70.

brittle.desc: +30% crit chance vs frozen; freezes last 30% longer.

glacial_heart.desc: Cold hits always chill; 40% more vs frozen; 20% less vs neither chilled nor frozen.

_masteries_about: Phase 4a mastery groups. A tree node of type 'mastery' names its group in 'mastery'; allocating it means choosing one option. An option id can be chosen at most once across the tree, so a group placed twice lets one character take two different options. Options use 'inc'/'flat' mods only (no 'more'). Changing a chosen option costs the refund price of one node.
_tree_sockets_about: Phase 4b tree sockets. A node of type 'socket' costs 1 and holds one gem from the pouch (free to socket, swap or remove; refunding the node returns the gem). The gem gives its 'tree' table from data/gems.json (scaled by tier mult) and, D4 glyph style, boosts the mods of allocated minor/greater/notable nodes within 'radius' (tree units) that share a tag with the gem's 'tree_tags' by boost_pct[tier] percent. A node in range of several matching sockets takes the largest boost (no stacking).
